content.text: Dear students, are you looking for studying Allied health sciences and confused about which course to choose? If you are interested in medicines then BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology is a perfect choice for you. BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology is a specialized undergraduate program in the field of Allied Health Sciences that equips students with the knowledge and skills to assist in anesthesia procedures and manage operation theatre equipment and protocols. Most of the colleges are affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of health sciences which provides quality course curriculum to students.

This 3-year degree program with one year compulsory internship is designed for students who aspire to do a major role in surgical and emergency care. As the demand for skilled OT technologists and anesthesia assistants grows in hospitals, nursing homes, trauma centers, and surgical units, pursuing this course opens up numerous opportunities. Karnataka, known as hub for medical education, have top colleges offering BSc in Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology with quality training and infrastructure. In this article, you will get to know detailed information about colleges offering anesthesia and Operation Theatre technology categorized by private and government, eligibility and admission process.

sections.heading: BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology Colleges in Karnataka Fees 2025

content.text: The fee structure for BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology colleges in Karnataka varies depending on the type of institution. For private colleges, the total course fee can range from ₹2,00,000 to ₹6,00,000 for the entire 3-year program, depending on the facilities, infrastructure, and reputation of the institution. Government colleges offer significantly lower tuition fees, typically ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹75,000 for the entire course, making them a highly affordable option for students. In private institutions, management quota seats may also carry a premium fee. Hostel, exam, and miscellaneous charges are usually separate and may differ across campuses.

sections.heading: BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology Colleges in Karnataka Eligibility Criteria

content.text: To get admitted into a BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology course in Karnataka, students must fulfill the following eligibility conditions:

items: Educational Qualification : Students have to complete 2nd PUC/10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as compulsory subjects.
Minimum Marks : Most colleges require a minimum of 45% aggregate marks in PCB. For reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC), there is usually a relaxation of 5%.
Age Limit : Candidates must be at least 17 years of age at the time of admission.
Additional Requirements : Some colleges might ask for a medical fitness certificate at the time of admission.

With the rapid growth in hospital infrastructure, both private and government, there’s an increasing demand for trained OT technologists and anesthesia assistants. Whether you aim for affordability with government institutions or advanced infrastructure in private ones, Karnataka has a wide range of options to choose from. sections.heading: What is the duration of the BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology course?

content.text: The course duration is 3 years, followed by a 6-month internship in most colleges.

sections.heading: Are there any entrance exams for admission in BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology in Karnataka?

content.text: For pursuing BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology, most colleges offer admission based on merit (12th marks). However, some private institutions may conduct their own entrance tests.

sections.heading: What are the career options after completing BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology?

content.text: BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology graduates can work as anesthesia technicians, OT technologists, surgical assistants, or pursue higher studies like MSc, MBA in Hospital Management, or related specializations.

sections.heading: Is NEET required for BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology?

content.text: No, NEET is not required for this course. Admission is usually based on Class 12th results.

sections.heading: Which is better a government or a private college?

content.text: Government colleges are more affordable, while private colleges may offer better infrastructure and placement support. It depends on your preferences and budget.
